name: Connacht
lore: Connacht: Ardee, Basar and the border keep of Druim Ligen, under the law of Tir na nOg - and beyond the farms, the Azure Order burns men in wicker, the fool-king's court laughs in the north-east woods, and the demon gate smoulders by Druim Ligen.

chains.title: The Phantom Wickermen
chains.hint: Smoke over the Wicker Fields - the Azure Order is building again...

stages.name: Clear Wicker Circle
stages.objective: Clear the wicker circle
stages.announce: The azure idolaters are raising a great wickerman south of the river, chanting to something in the north. It must not be lit.
stages.success: You have cleared the wicker circle. The Burning Wickerman comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the wicker circle. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: The Burning Wickerman
stages.objective: Defeat the Burning Wickerman
stages.announce: The Burning Wickerman walks out of its own fire. The idolaters cheer. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Burning Wickerman falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: The Burning Wickerman slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Phantom Wickermans Hold the Road to Druim Ligen
stages.objective: Drive the phantom wickermans off the road to Druim Ligen
stages.announce: With The Phantom Wickermen lost, the phantom wickermans have spread down onto the road to Druim Ligen and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The phantom wickermans are gone from the road to Druim Ligen. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Aine, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Aine has come out to set the road to Druim Ligen right. The phantom wickermans are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Druim Ligen is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The phantom wickermans break and scatter. The road to Druim Ligen is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Aine falls, and the phantom wickermans take the road back.

chains.title: The Woodward
chains.hint: The Irewood is moving, and the woodward has gone to calm it...

stages.name: Protect Muireann the Woodward
stages.objective: Protect Muireann the Woodward, who is tending the oak saplings
stages.announce: Muireann the woodward is saving the oak saplings the Irewood has left. It's angry - the Azure Order has been felling it for wicker - and it's coming for anyone with an axe, or anyone at all.
stages.success: "That's done," says Muireann the Woodward. "They came from over there - let's finish this."
stages.fail: Muireann the Woodward falls. The attackers are left to do as they please - for now.

stages.name: Clear Woodward's Grove
stages.objective: Clear the woodward's grove
stages.announce: They came from the woodward's grove. Follow them back and clear it out.
stages.success: You have cleared the woodward's grove. Elder Irewood comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the woodward's grove. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Elder Irewood
stages.objective: Defeat Elder Irewood
stages.announce: Elder Irewood stands at the woodward's grove. Bring friends.
stages.success: Elder Irewood falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: Elder Irewood slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Streaming Wisps Hold the Road to Basar
stages.objective: Drive the streaming wisps off the road to Basar
stages.announce: With The Woodward lost, the streaming wisps have spread down onto the road to Basar and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The streaming wisps are gone from the road to Basar. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Cormac, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Cormac has come out to set the road to Basar right. The streaming wisps are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Basar is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The streaming wisps break and scatter. The road to Basar is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Cormac falls, and the streaming wisps take the road back.

chains.title: The Wind Ghouls
chains.hint: Sentinel Andreasa is looking for help in Basar.

giver.name: Sentinel Andreasa
giver.greet: The wind ghouls are getting bold - they took a shepherd off the moor last night. A shepherd says he saw blue fire carried across the heath the night they rose. I'm going after them. Will you come? Tell me when you're [ready].
giver.reply: Good. Stay close - they will have watchers out. With me!
giver.busy: We've only just come back. Give my people a while to rest, then find me again.

stages.name: The Road to Ghoul Moor
stages.objective: Go with Sentinel Andreasa to the ghoul moor
stages.announce: Sentinel Andreasa leads the sentinels of Basar out onto the ghoul moor.
stages.success: Sentinel Andreasa reaches the ghoul moor. "There they are. Clear them out!"
stages.fail: Sentinel Andreasa falls on the road. The others carry the body home.

stages.name: Clear Ghoul Moor
stages.objective: Clear the ghoul moor
stages.announce: Clear the ghoul moor!
stages.success: You have cleared the ghoul moor. Cathal of the Four Winds comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the ghoul moor. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Cathal of the Four Winds
stages.objective: Defeat Cathal of the Four Winds
stages.announce: Cathal of the Four Winds stands at the ghoul moor. Bring friends.
stages.success: Cathal of the Four Winds falls. Basar will hear of this in the taverns tonight.
stages.fail: Cathal of the Four Winds slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Wind Ghouls Hold the Road to Basar
stages.objective: Drive the wind ghouls off the road to Basar
stages.announce: With The Wind Ghouls lost, the wind ghouls have spread down onto the road to Basar and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The wind ghouls are gone from the road to Basar. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Ruadh, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Ruadh has come out to set the road to Basar right. The wind ghouls are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Basar is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The wind ghouls break and scatter. The road to Basar is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Ruadh falls, and the wind ghouls take the road back.

chains.title: The Wrathful Sprites
chains.hint: Shrieks of rage come from a blackthorn thicket by the Wicker Fields...

stages.name: Clear Sprites' Blackthorn
stages.objective: Clear the sprites' blackthorn
stages.announce: Anger sprites have woken the lunantishee in the blackthorn, and nothing that walks near it comes back sane. Cut it down.
stages.success: You have cleared the sprites' blackthorn. The Wrathful One comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the sprites' blackthorn. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: The Wrathful One
stages.objective: Defeat the Wrathful One
stages.announce: The Wrathful One stands at the sprites' blackthorn. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Wrathful One falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: The Wrathful One slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Anger Sprites Hold the Road to Druim Ligen
stages.objective: Drive the anger sprites off the road to Druim Ligen
stages.announce: With The Wrathful Sprites lost, the anger sprites have spread down onto the road to Druim Ligen and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The anger sprites are gone from the road to Druim Ligen. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Ruadh, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Ruadh has come out to set the road to Druim Ligen right. The anger sprites are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Druim Ligen is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The anger sprites break and scatter. The road to Druim Ligen is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Ruadh falls, and the anger sprites take the road back.

chains.title: The Gate Stirs
chains.hint: The demon gate by Druim Ligen burns brighter after dark...

stages.name: The Watch-Post
stages.objective: Keep Sentinel Cathbarr alive at the gate watch-post
stages.announce: The demon gate flares blue - azure fire, fed from somewhere west. Manes pour out at the Fianna's watch-post. Hold it!
stages.thanks: "Still standing. Still standing! Druim Ligen owes you a drink."
stages.success: The manes break - and the gate roars. Something big is climbing through.
stages.fail: Sentinel Cathbarr falls. The demons spill out onto the north road.

stages.name: Morcant of the Gate
stages.objective: Defeat Morcant of the Gate
stages.announce: Morcant of the Gate steps out of the fire, wreathed in blue. 'The fires in the west feed me. Every wicker they burn opens the door a little wider.' Bring friends.
stages.success: Morcant falls back into the fire, and the gate dims to embers. For tonight.
stages.fail: Morcant holds the gate, and the night belongs to the demons.

stages.name: Demons Hold the North Road
stages.objective: Drive the demons off the north road
stages.announce: The demons hold the north road between the gate and Druim Ligen. Nothing gets through to the keep.
stages.success: The north road is clear. The Fianna can relieve the watch-post.

stages.name: Relieve the Watch-Post
stages.objective: Keep Sentinel Orlaith alive while she re-lights the watch-fire
stages.announce: Sentinel Orlaith of the Fianna is re-lighting the watch-fire. The gate sends what it has left!
stages.thanks: "The watch-fire burns. Druim Ligen sees the gate again."
stages.success: The watch-post is the Fianna's again.
stages.fail: Sentinel Orlaith falls, and the demons take the road back.

chains.title: The Fool's Revel
chains.hint: Laughter and pipes in the north-east woods, after dark...

stages.name: The Procession
stages.objective: Stop the revel-leader before he reaches the Fool's Court
stages.announce: The Touched are dancing a line of sleep-walking farmhands from Basar into the Fool's Court. Stop the revel before it reaches the Amadan!
stages.success: The Revel-Leader falls and the farmhands wake, blinking, in the trees. Somewhere ahead, the music turns angry.
stages.fail: The revel dances into the Fool's Court, and the farmhands go with it.

stages.name: the Lord of Misrule
stages.objective: Defeat the Lord of Misrule
stages.announce: A pookha in a crown of antlers and blue beads steps out of the dance. 'You spoiled the Amadan's party. Now you're the entertainment.' Bring friends.
stages.success: The Lord of Misrule falls apart into leaves and laughter. The farmhands are going home. Among the leaves: a string of blue-glass beads.
stages.fail: The Lord of Misrule keeps his revel. Basar will be short of hands come morning.

chains.title: Siabra on the River
chains.hint: Siabra boats on the river by Basar...

stages.name: The Mill
stages.objective: Keep Miller Fionnuala alive at Basar's mill
stages.announce: Siabra raiders are coming up the river bank to burn Basar's mill. Miller Fionnuala won't leave her stones!
stages.thanks: "My stones are whole. Go - they're at the ferry!"
stages.success: The raiders break off from the mill - and make for the ferry.
stages.fail: Miller Fionnuala falls, and the mill burns.

stages.name: The Ferry
stages.objective: Keep Ferryman Breasal alive at the ferry
stages.announce: The siabra want the ferry - with it they can cross whenever they like. Hold it!
stages.thanks: "Not my ferry, you pale devils. Not today."
stages.success: The raiders fall back to their boats, and their captain comes ashore himself.
stages.fail: Ferryman Breasal falls. The siabra have the river crossing.

stages.name: Captain Scathach
stages.objective: Defeat Captain Scathach of the siabra raiders
stages.announce: Captain Scathach wades out of the shallows, a bag of blue-glass beads at her belt. 'Paid in advance. Burn the mill.' Bring friends.
stages.success: Scathach falls in the shallows. Her purse is full of blue-glass beads - the Azure Order's coin.
stages.fail: Scathach drives you back, and her raiders take the crossing.

stages.name: The Raiders Hold Basar's Crossing
stages.objective: Drive the siabra off Basar's crossing
stages.announce: The siabra raiders hold Basar's river crossing. Every cart over it pays them - in blood.
stages.success: The crossing is clear. Basar will want its ferry back.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Keep Ferryman Breasal alive while he raises the ferry
stages.announce: Ferryman Breasal is raising his sunken ferry. The raiders come back for it!
stages.thanks: "She floats! Basar's crossing is open again."
stages.success: The ferry is back on the river.
stages.fail: Ferryman Breasal falls, and the raiders take the crossing back.

chains.title: The Fishing Bears' Bad Year
chains.hint: Fisher Deirdre is looking for help on the river by Basar.

giver.name: Fisher Deirdre
giver.greet: The salmon are running and the bears have had a bad year - thin as rakes, and bold with it. They've chased us off our own river. Will you net me a basket of salmon while they're at it? Say when you're [ready].
giver.reply: Mind the big one. There's always a big one.
giver.busy: I'm still salting the last lot. Come back a little later.
giver.thanks: A full basket - Basar eats this week. Here, for your trouble.

stages.name: Salmon for Basar
stages.objective: Net leaping salmon in the shallows (click them)
stages.announce: The salmon leap in the shallows by Basar - and the fishing bears want every one.
stages.success: The basket's full - and the biggest bear on the river has smelt it.
stages.fail: The salmon run thins out. The bears have had the best of it.

stages.name: Mother Pikebane
stages.objective: Defeat Mother Pikebane
stages.announce: Mother Pikebane - Pikebane's own dam, grey to the shoulders - comes down to the river for the basket. Bring friends.
stages.success: Mother Pikebane lumbers off into the trees, beaten and grumbling. The river is Basar's again.
stages.fail: Mother Pikebane scatters the basket.

chains.title: Retake the Wicker Fields
chains.hint: The Order of the Rowan is gathering a war band at the edge of the Wicker Fields.

giver.name: Bebhinn of the Rowan
giver.greet: The Azure Order has burned these fields for a generation. Not one more wicker. Gather four at least - bots and all - and when you're ready, tell me you're [ready to burn them out].
giver.reply: Follow the rowan-berries. Break the circles while they chant - all three at once, or they'll relight them!
giver.thanks: The fields are free. We'll plant rowan where the wicker stood.
giver.regret: Back, back! We'll try again when we're stronger.

stages.name: The Wicker Circles
stages.objective: Break the three wicker circles and hold them together
stages.announce: Three wicker circles burn blue - west, east and south by the river - and the idolaters chant at each. Take all three at once: split up!
stages.success: The last circle goes dark. In the middle of the fields the great wicker catches - and something inside it speaks.
stages.fail: The circles burn on. The war band falls back to the rowan grove.

stages.name: the Voice of the Azure
stages.objective: Defeat the Voice of the Azure in the burning wicker
stages.announce: The Voice of the Azure steps out of the burning wicker, robes alight and unharmed. 'The fool-king promised me the gate. You'll make a fine wicker.'
stages.success: The Voice falls into the fire it lit. The wicker collapses into ash, and the fields are quiet for the first time in years.
stages.fail: The Voice holds the fields. The war band breaks for the grove.

chains.title: The Azure Fire Returns
chains.hint: Blue fire on the hills: the Azure Order has come back to burn the Rowan grove.

stages.name: The Grove Burns
stages.objective: Keep Grove-Warden Lasairiona alive
stages.announce: Idolaters with torches come down from every hill. Save the grove!
stages.success: The torch-bearers break - and their fire-priest comes down the hill himself.
stages.fail: The grove burns.

stages.name: the Fire-Priest
stages.objective: Defeat the Azure fire-priest
stages.announce: An idolater in a burning mask: 'The Voice is ash, but the fire remembers. Burn it all!'
stages.success: The fire-priest falls. The grove stands - for now.
stages.fail: The fire-priest's torch takes the grove. The Wicker Fields burn again.

siege.name: the Wicker Fields
siege.open_text: Hear me! The Order of the Rowan says the Azure Order can be driven from the Wicker Fields! Bebhinn of the Rowan waits at the edge of the fields for a war band. If no one leads them within the half-hour, they'll go without you.
siege.taken_text: The Wicker Fields are free! The Order of the Rowan is planting a grove where the circles stood - go and see.
siege.repelled_text: The assault on the Wicker Fields has been thrown back. The Azure fires burn higher.
siege.raid_text: The Azure Order is coming back to burn the Rowan grove!
siege.held_text: The torch-bearers are beaten off. The Rowan grove stands.
siege.fall_text: The Rowan grove has burned. The Azure Order holds the Wicker Fields again - and the Rowan must rebuild its resolve.
siege.carry_text: The Rowan druids lead you through the smoke into the Wicker Fields.
siege.carried_cry: The war band wouldn't wait any longer - the Rowan druids have led them into {0}!

camp_npcs.name: Grove-Keeper Ailbhe
camp_npcs.greet: Field-grown, every piece - rowan from the first saplings. For those who freed the fields, and those who hold them.

camp_npcs.name: Herbalist Fiadh
camp_npcs.greet: Rowan, elder, meadowsweet. The fields grow good herbs once the fire's out of them. Coin, mind.

camp_npcs.name: Rowan druid
camp_npcs.idle: First rowan in these fields in thirty years. Keep the torches away from it.

camp_npcs.name: Fennid Colla
camp_npcs.greet: Champion Fiachra lent us to the druids. Can't say I mind - better than watching the gate.
camp_npcs.idle: They'll be back. Fire-worshippers always come back for the fire.
